blocks.text: Twelve days at the height of Carnival, combining three distinct sides of Brazil: four nights in Rio de Janeiro, with Sugar Loaf, the historic centre, Corcovado and the unforgettable overnight parade of samba schools at the Sambadrome. Next, fly to Iguazu Falls for views from both the Brazilian and Argentine sides. After a week of sightseeing, enjoy four nights relaxing on the beaches of Búzios.
